reasons: review: The cache lookup (app.py ~375, cache.get) is keyed only by workspace, task, quality and messages, not by model. An `open_weight_only` request can therefore get a cached answer that a non-open-weight model produced. That breaks the rule that only open-weight models may serve the request. The cache hit needs filtering by open-weight model, or the cache needs to be bypassed, when the option is set.

reasons: review: When there are fewer than `keep_last` non-system messages (for example, several system messages that get past the early-return length check), `cut` goes negative. `rest[:cut]` and `rest[cut:]` then split the list at the wrong place. Recent turns get condensed into the digest, where the old code kept them all. The fix is `cut = max(0, len(rest) - keep_last)`.
